description: This file defines the EducationModel class used for representing education entities in the OrangeHRM system's API module. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization, serving as a data transfer object within the API layer.

classes.name: EducationModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing Education entity data for API responses. Implements normalization of Education data with specified filters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an Education entity and sets filter fields 'id' and 'name'.
